TPS reader attribution

native/tps.cpp adapts the file format algorithms in tps-parse:
Copyright 2012-2013 E.Hooijmeijer
https://github.com/ctrl-alt-dev/tps-parse
Apache License, Version 2.0. Full text: Apache-2.0.txt.

Reference classes: TpsHeader, TpsBlock, TpsPage, TpsRecord, TpsFile,
RandomAccess, TableDefinitionRecord, FieldDefinitionRecord,
MemoDefinitionRecord, MemoHeader, MemoRecord, AbstractHeader and decrypt/Key.

The C++ adaptation adds strict bounds and size limits, conflict detection,
read-only source access, Windows-1252 text handling, and SQLite migration.
It does not claim complete TopSpeed format or legacy business-rule compatibility.

Qt is dynamically linked and is not vendored into this source tree. Distributing
a packaged application must also include the notices/licences for the Qt build
used to package it. The supplied legacy data and Windows software are not part of
this project's source distribution.

Airline reference data

native/reference/airlines.json includes public airline facts from IATA's member
directory and OpenFlights contributors. The OpenFlights-derived database is
distributed under ODbL 1.0, with individual contents under DbCL 1.0:
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/
https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/dbcl/1-0/
See native/reference/README.txt for attribution, processing and source limits.
These database licenses do not apply to private shipments or application code.

Inter 4.1 regular and italic variable fonts are bundled, unmodified, under the
SIL Open Font License 1.1. See native/fonts/OFL.txt for the full license and
native/fonts/README.txt for source/version/checksums. The application embeds the
fonts and license; Help > Inter font license displays the license offline.
